prompt: Make the "Free and open source" line be little sticker badges that pop in one after the other

messages.text: Make the "Free and open source" line be little sticker badges that pop in one after the other

ran ls sites/timsrobot.com 2>/dev/null; trif run 'const w=document.evaluate("//*[contains(text(),\"Free and open source\")]",document,null,9,null).singleNodeValue; return {tag:w?.tagName, cls:w?.className, html:w?.outerHTML.slice(0,500), par…
ran grep -l "small\|hero" sites/timsrobot.com/*.js; trif status | tail -8; trif new timsrobot.com stickers
ran trif status | tail -8; trif new timsrobot.com stickers

ran trif check timsrobot.com/stickers && trif reload && trif run 'await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return [...document.querySelectorAll(".sb-badge")].map(b=>[b.textContent,getComputedStyle(b).opacity])' && trif errors && trif screenshot --t…
Mod's written and loaded; checking it on the page now.
ran trif run '[...document.querySelectorAll(".sb-badge")].map(b=>[b.textContent,getComputedStyle(b).opacity])'; trif errors; trif screenshot

The line under the tagline is now three tilted stickers: **Free & open source** (green), **In beta** (yellow) and **For Mac** (pink). Each has a white border and a drop shadow. When the page loads they pop in one after another with a small bounce, and each one straightens and grows a little when you hover over it.

- **What I checked:** after a reload, all three badges showed up on the page, the mod threw no errors, and a screenshot showed them as intended. The robot that was partly covering the first badge in the screenshot is your "Living Robot" mod walking past.
- **Accessibility:** screen readers still read the original sentence. If your Mac is set to reduce motion, the badges appear without the animation.

To undo it, switch off **Sticker Badges** in the side panel, or ask me to.
